objectives.description: Pick representative 5-file touched set, resolve via suite-selection-lib.sh, run --only on real battery
Measure wall clock for selected vs full sweep, same host, stated load condition
Prove strict-subset property against a fresh full-sweep run
Prove no-flag byte-identity on the real battery (modulo nondeterministic fields)
Confirm mechanism parity on the real battery
Confirm whole scripts/tests/ battery still passes, no suite weakened/skipped/deleted
shellcheck clean across all three touched shell files
Fix Gate 3 doc-lint finding discovered during full verify-deploy.sh run (suite-selection-lib.sh missing from provides.scripts)

approaches_tried.approach: Literal diff of a fresh full-sweep transcript against Phase 1's reference transcript for the no-flag byte-identity proof
approaches_tried.reason: Produced a very large diff, but traced entirely to two pre-existing, independent factors: (1) host-load-driven suite flakiness -- the SET of failing suites shifted between Phase 1's baseline (5 failures) and this fresh run (3 failures, 2 of which persist from Phase 1's set), so a suite that failed in one run and passed in the other causes its multi-hundred-line [FAIL] output dump to appear in only one transcript; (2) ongoing corpus population drift from concurrent sibling commits (93->95->123 narrow+flat suites tracked across phases, traced to specific named sibling files). Neither factor is caused by the --only addition. The rigorous, exact byte-identity proof instead lives in Phase 4's deterministic synthetic fixture (case5, exact string match); on the real battery, format-level identity was confirmed directly (the tally-line/roster/[RUN]-[PASS]-[FAIL] templates are byte-identical in shape between the two transcripts, differing only in the numbers/suite names a different run naturally produces).

approaches_tried.approach: git add the whole manifest.json pathspec to commit the Gate 3 doc-lint fix
approaches_tried.reason: A concurrent sibling task had simultaneously added 3 of its own uncommitted entries to the same file (same array, additive-only hunks). git-commit-scoped.sh's git add always re-reads the full working-tree file, so committing the pathspec directly would have swept the sibling's uncommitted work into this task's commit under the wrong provenance. Fixed by temporarily removing the sibling's 3 lines from the working tree, committing cleanly with only this task's own hunk, then restoring the sibling's lines back into the uncommitted working tree exactly as they were (verified via diff against a pre-edit snapshot).

deviations.description: Plan task says 'Record both --jobs 1 and --jobs auto if the load condition permits'
deviations.reason: Host load was measured at 6.12-12.90 throughout this phase's measurement window (heavier than Phase 1's already-heavy 3.99-8.03), well past the point where a --jobs 1 re-measurement would add meaningful signal beyond what Phase 1 already recorded at --jobs 1 (1,276,085ms) -- the load condition explicitly did not permit a second, even-slower --jobs 1 pass. Only --jobs auto was measured in Phase 5.
deviations.annotation: *(deviation: altered -- --jobs 1 not re-measured, load did not permit; see progress file)*
